key_catalyst: The FOMC's rare 9-3 hawkish hold and resulting 10-year yield spike to 4.70%
reasoning: Microsoft and semiconductor strength validated parts of the AI-demand narrative, but the rare 9-3 hawkish Fed hold drove the 10-year yield to 4.70%, while Meta's collapsing free cash flow revived unresolved AI-capex concerns. Because the session's support was concentrated and did not broadly resolve the risks behind the July 24 and July 28-29 selloffs, overnight gap-down risk is material.
